description: This file contains implementation of YOLOv3 object detection model using TensorFlow Keras, including custom layers, model architecture, and training functions.

classes.name: YoloLayer
classes.description: Custom Keras layer implementing YOLOv3 detection logic, including bounding box adjustments, IoU calculations, and loss components.

methods.name: dummy_loss
methods.description: A placeholder loss function that computes the square root of the sum of predictions.

methods.name: NetworkConv2D_BN_Leaky
methods.description: Creates a Conv2D layer followed by BatchNormalization and LeakyReLU activation.

methods.name: residual_block
methods.description: Builds a residual block with multiple convolutional layers and skip connections.

methods.name: darknet
methods.description: Constructs the Darknet backbone network with residual blocks.

methods.name: last_layers
methods.description: Builds the final convolutional layers for detection heads.

methods.name: yolov3_base
methods.description: Creates the base YOLOv3 architecture with multi-scale detection layers.

methods.name: yolov3_main
methods.description: Constructs the full YOLOv3 model for inference.

methods.name: yolov3_train
methods.description: Builds the training model with custom YOLO loss layers.

methods.name: tiny_yolov3_main
methods.description: Creates a smaller, simplified YOLOv3 model for faster inference.
